meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning: a hostile team cross-critiques a plan before it is formalized. Use when planning needs maximum rigor or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让多个 AI 互相唱反调,把方案在定稿前反复挑刺打磨。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在重要决策前想先让立场不同的 AI 相互找茬。
copy.tagline_en: Pit multiple AI agents against each other to stress-test a plan before it is finalized.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want opposing AI voices to challenge a critical plan before committing.

howto.what: Claude 会先喊「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!」,然后组建一支 5 人对抗团队互相挑错,只留下扛住攻击的结论,再交给专门的 planner 写成正式计划。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度,或你要求做 hyperplan、对抗式或交叉批判式计划时触发;它需要团队工具已启用,且当前是顶层会话。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我做这个规划
say.note: 进入对抗模式,先组建 5 人团队

say.text: 这个方案请按对抗式交叉批判来规划
say.note: 成员互相攻击,只留站得住的观点

say.text: 帮我规划并找出方案里最脆弱的地方
say.note: 暴露过度设计与遗漏的边界情况

howto.what_en: Claude first says "HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!", then forms a 5-member adversarial team that cross-attacks each other, keeps only surviving insights, and hands them to a dedicated planner for formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when planning needs maximum rigor, or the user asks for a hyperplan / adversarial or cross-critique plan. Requires the team tools to be enabled and a top-level lead session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this for me
say_en.note: Enters adversarial mode and spawns 5 members

say_en.text: Plan this as an adversarial cross-critique plan
say_en.note: Members attack each other; only survivors remain

say_en.text: Plan this and find the weakest points
say_en.note: Exposes over-engineering and missed edge cases
